speaker: Mia
text: Welcome to our veggie shop, Max! Big smiles, big baskets!

speaker: Max
text: And big questions. Do vegetables take credit cards?

speaker: Mia
text: Only if you lettuce pay! Ha ha!

speaker: Max
text: That joke was so fresh, it still has roots.

speaker: Mia
text: First, red tomatoes! Juicy, round, and delicious.

speaker: Max
text: Are tomatoes vegetables, or sneaky little fruits?

speaker: Mia
text: Botanically fruits, but in cooking we call them veggies.

speaker: Max
text: Aha! Double agents in the salad bowl!

speaker: Mia
text: Look at these orange carrots. They are crunchy root vegetables.

speaker: Max
text: Do carrots help rabbits see in the dark?

speaker: Mia
text: They provide vitamin A helpers for healthy vision.

speaker: Max
text: Then why is that rabbit wearing sunglasses?

speaker: Mia
text: Next, potatoes! We can bake, mash, or roast them.

speaker: Max
text: A potato told me it felt mashed today.

speaker: Mia
text: That is a very starchy joke, Max.

speaker: Max
text: Thank you. I practice every fry-day!

speaker: Mia
text: Here are onions, with layers and a strong smell.

speaker: Max
text: I chopped one, and my eyes started a swimming lesson!

speaker: Mia
text: And cucumbers are crisp and cool in salads.

speaker: Max
text: I told a cucumber to chill. It was already cool!

speaker: Mia
text: Now meet broccoli. Its green tops look like tiny trees.

speaker: Max
text: A miniature forest! Where do the broccoli squirrels live?

speaker: Mia
text: Probably somewhere near our leafy green spinach.

speaker: Max
text: Will spinach turn my shopping bags into dumbbells?

speaker: Mia
text: It offers nutrients, but strong muscles still need practice.

speaker: Max
text: Aw! I was hoping for instant superhero mode!

speaker: Mia
text: These shiny bell peppers come in many colors.

speaker: Max
text: Do they ring? Hello! Anybody bell pepper home?

speaker: Mia
text: No ringing, but they are sweet and wonderfully crunchy.

speaker: Max
text: Fine! I will answer the door with a carrot.

speaker: Mia
text: Eggplants are purple, and also called aubergines.

speaker: Max
text: Aubergine sounds like a vegetable who owns a castle!

speaker: Mia
text: This huge orange pumpkin is perfect for tasty soup.

speaker: Max
text: And a spooky coach that turns into midnight snacks!

speaker: Mia
text: We also have peas, corn, and snowy cauliflower.

speaker: Max
text: Peas be kind! That cauliflower has a cloud haircut!

speaker: Mia
text: Review time! Tomato, carrot, potato, onion, cucumber.

speaker: Max
text: Broccoli, spinach, bell pepper, eggplant, pumpkin!

speaker: Mia
text: And peas, corn, cauliflower. Which would you choose?

speaker: Max
text: All of them! Can vegetables join my comedy club?

speaker: Mia
text: Of course! Just keep the jokes extra fresh.

speaker: Max
text: Thanks for shopping, friends! Stay crunchy, stay smiling!

speaker: Mia
text: See you next time at the veggie shop. Bye!

speaker: Max
text: Bye! Oh, and lettuce go home!
